stem: A team keeps 50 of its 50,000 customers, 0.1%, as a holdout to measure a year of campaigns. What is the main problem?

options.text: The holdout is too large, so it costs too much revenue each year
There is none: a random holdout of any size gives a precise answer
A holdout must be exactly 5% of all customers to give a valid answer
50 customers are too few to detect a realistic effect of the campaigns
